احتياطات السلامة

A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 ID category,

Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,

Safety and healthy equipment must be used as 
 safety shoes, and safety Helmet ... etc.

No smoking beside the generator is filled by 
 hydrogen gas.

Never remove more than one brush from exciter 
 (ground fault detection system).
The unit in service.

 rod.

 fluid and clothes.
العمل المراد تنفيذه
Check automatic operation of seal oil pump.
Check that standby seal oil pump is ready for operation.
Check bearing vapor exhausters for automatic operation.
Check oil level in vacuum pump.
Drain liquid from oil traps.
Check degree of contamination of seal oil filters.
Perform cooler changeover.
Check seal oil supply lines and shutoff valves for leakages.
